- set explicit, platform-independent ZipInfo metadata for every member: create_system = 3, external_attr = 0o644 << 16, compress_type = ZIP_DEFLATED, and the existing fixed date_time; keep member naming and ordering unchanged. Define the values as named constants.
- regenerate both fixtures with their builders (only spansh-system-dumps.zip and manifest.json may change in each; canonical.json and source-metadata.json must stay byte-identical; prove member names and decompressed member bytes are unchanged versus the branch head for both zips).
